intent: Repair the immutable campaign provider so campaign-cycle and operator-transition monotonicity are enforced as independent coordinates: a later cycle cannot replay an older control state, and a legitimate later operator transition can be observed without inventing a new campaign cycle when the nested snapshot remains exact.

interface_mismatches: Campaign cycle_sequence and operator transition_sequence are distinct monotonic domains, but the provider currently binds both only through one campaign-position digest.
A campaign cycle may advance without an operator transition, while an operator transition may be projected before another campaign cycle; neither domain may roll back or equivocate.
The prior same-cycle evidence-equivocation test incorrectly rejects a legitimate higher operator transition and fails to test the dangerous later-cycle operator rollback.
honest_blockers: Both monotonic high-water marks remain process-local; configured generation and freshness/custody checks bound but do not durably eliminate cross-process replay.
This repair changes read-model admission only and does not apply control authority or observe a provider-side effect.
Independent exact-commit rereview is required before the projection range is accepted.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the split campaign/operator digests and high-water checks, the two adversarial fixtures, and this packet. This reopens the demonstrated control-state replay and must not be used as an operational rollback while the campaign is live.
